verdict.rationale: Termius ships its own built-in AI feature, an AI widget that turns a plain-language description into a shell command. That is a narrow form of delegation: the evidence shows only command generation, not an assistant that plans or carries out multi-step tasks. missing for 10: evidence of agentic task execution (multi-step plans, running and iterating on commands), conversational assistant depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Termius generates the command using AI.
Termius can generate commands from plain-language descriptions.
